finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::no test covers login.ts's actual hand-off: that `open()` and stderr receive `starturl` and not the nonce-bearing url
evidence: packages/cli/test/login-callback.test.ts's "keeps the nonce out of the URL handed to the browser and to stderr" test (~lines 188–212) only asserts on startCallbackServer's returned startUrl and the /start redirect; it never runs the login action handler, mocks open(), or captures stderr, and the registerLoginCommand test (~line 226) only checks the command/option exist. Reverting login.ts:67/72 (console.error and open(startUrl)) to the nonce-carrying buildAuthorizeUrl would pass all supplied tests, so the named hand-off property is indeed untested. Confidence is medium only because other CLI test files (bin.test.ts, namespaces.test.ts) were not supplied, though nothing suggests they cover the login hand-off. It is a test gap, not a shipped-behavior defect, hence minor.
